name: Orange and Walnut Salad
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Three or four tablespoonfuls of olive oil
ingredients.originalText: Three or four tablespoonfuls of olive oil

ingredients.name: sliced nut meats
ingredients.originalText: One cupful of sliced nut meats

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.originalText: Half a teaspoonful of lemon juice

instructions.text: Slice oranges lengthwise, dress with three or four tablespoonfuls of olive oil and one tablespoonful of lemon-juice.
Arrange slices in a mound upon a layer of lettuce leaves.
Dress one cupful of sliced nut meats with one tablespoonful of oil, a dash of salt and half a teaspoonful of lemon juice, and dispose upon the centre of mound.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Slice oranges lengthwise, dress with three or four tablespoonfuls of olive oil and one tablespoonful of lemon-juice.
2. Arrange slices in a mound upon a layer of lettuce leaves.
3. Dress one cupful of sliced nut meats with one tablespoonful of oil, a dash of salt and half a teaspoonful of lemon juice, and dispose upon the centre of mound.
4. Mix together before serving.
originalIngredients: Three or four tablespoonfuls of olive oil
One cupful of sliced nut meats
Half a teaspoonful of lemon juice
